title.rendered: Celebration of the fifth anniversary of the Monastic Order

content.rendered:
On September 29, 2024, the Prince Abbot of Sabourg, His Most Reverend Highness Monsignor Giovanni Luca, opened the celebrations for the fifth anniversary of the Monastic Order, congratulating all the dignitaries and collaborators who, through their active participation and constant work, made it possible to reach this milestone.

The Prince Abbot, together with the Secretary of State and the Minister of the Department of Communication, H.E. Florence de Barros Contì, welcomed the swearing-in of the Minister of the new Department of Sport, H.E. Dr. Stéphane FOUCHER, and the Minister of the Department of Health, H.E. Frédéric Pfeferberg.

During the event, an appeal was made to all those eligible for Sabourg citizenship, in view of the imminent opening of the Sabourg census.
